root_causes.description: Checkout service pods experiencing massive restart activity (z>1000), causing cascading errors to dependent services including frontend. Pod events confirm 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' with 2 restart events observed.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted (count=2)
evidence.observed_value: 2 container restart events in investigation window

root_causes.description: Product-catalog service shows significant p99 latency spike (z=+6.48, window=26.1ms) above baseline of 22.44ms, potentially contributing to downstream checkout failures since checkout depends on product-catalog per topology.

Payment service shows elevated memory usage (z=+5.97, window=1.25e+08 bytes) above baseline of 1.212e+08 bytes, potentially leading to OOM conditions and pod restarts that could cascade through the dependency chain.

remediation_steps: Restart checkout pods or roll back recent deployment changes that triggered container definition changes
Investigate and resolve product-catalog latency spike to improve downstream checkout performance
Monitor payment memory usage and consider increasing resource limits or optimizing memory footprint
